raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

`extra_key` is the request's prefix-cache namespace: the scheduler keys radix-cache entries by it, so two requests share cached prefixes only under the same key. The Python `/generate` route honours it (`GenerateReqInput._normalize_extra_key`), and the OpenAI-compatible processors in `rust/sglang-processor` already forward it into the native body (`"extra_key": request.extra_key`), but the Rust frontend's `/generate` schema did not carry the field. In Rust mode it was dropped as an unknown key, so every request landed in one cache namespace and requests sent under different keys could reuse each other's cached prefixes.

## Modifications

- `proto/sglang/api/v1/generate.proto`: add `extra_key` (tag 23, `StringOrList`) to `GenerateRequest`; regenerated `api_types.py`, `sglang.api.v1.rs` and `sglang.api.v1.serde.rs` with `cargo gen-api`.
- `rust/sglang-server/src/message/request.rs`: fan `extra_key` out with the Python semantics: one key broadcasts to every item, a list is per item and must match the batch size, an empty key means none, and a list on a single (non-batch) request is a 400 (`extra_key should be a string for a single request.`), as in `GenerateReqInput`.
- `rust/sglang-server/src/message/io_struct.rs`: carry it into the scheduler header's `extra_key` slot. The header is decoded positionally (`TokenizedGenerateReqInput` is an `array_like` msgspec struct), so the three slots before it (`routing_key`, `require_reasoning`, `priority`) are now emitted at their defaults; the header grows from 32 to 36 entries. Everything after `extra_key` still has a msgspec default and stays omitted.
- `test/registered/unit/api/v1/test_parity.py`: `extra_key` leaves the pinned list of Python-only request fields.

## Accuracy Tests

Not applicable: the change only affects which prefix-cache namespace a request is placed in, not the generated tokens.

## Benchmarking and Profiling

Not applicable.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Code Formatting with Pre-Commit](https://docs.sglang.ai/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-formatting-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests as outlined in the [Running Unit Tests](https://docs.sglang.ai/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#running-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation / docstrings / example tutorials as needed, according to [Writing Documentation](https://docs.sglang.ai/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#writing-documentation).
- [x] Provide throughput / latency benchmark results and accuracy evaluation results as needed, according to [Benchmark and Profiling](https://docs.sglang.ai/developer_guide/benchmark_and_profiling.html) and [Accuracy Results](https://docs.sglang.ai/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#accuracy-results).
- [x] For reviewers: If you haven't made any contributions to this PR and are only assisting with merging the main branch, please remove yourself as a co-author when merging.
- [x] Please feel free to join our Slack channel at https://slack.sglang.io to discuss your PR.

## Test plan

- `cargo fmt --all -- --check`; `cargo clippy --locked -p sglang-server -p sglang-api-types --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- `cargo test --locked -p sglang-server -p sglang-api-types`: 319 + 21 passed, 0 failed, including the new `extra_key_fans_out` and the header-alignment test extended to slots 32-35 (`routing_key`, `require_reasoning`, `priority`, `extra_key`), whose indices were read from the Python `TokenizedGenerateReqInput` field order.
- `cargo gen-api` reproduces the checked-in generated files byte for byte.
- `test/registered/unit/api/v1/test_parity.py`, `test/registered/unit/api/v1/test_json_contract.py`, `test/registered/unit/entrypoints/test_generate_api_contract.py`: 40 passed, 28 subtests.

files.patch:
@@ -257,6 +257,7 @@ class GenerateRequest(msgspec.Struct, kw_only=True, frozen=True):
     mm_hashes: Optional[StringListOrList] = None
     video_data: Optional[MediaInput] = None
     audio_data: Optional[MediaInput] = None
+    extra_key: Optional[StringOrList] = None
 
     @classmethod
     def from_json_value(cls, value: Any) -> "GenerateRequest":
@@ -1096,6 +1097,8 @@ def decode_GenerateRequest(value: Any) -> GenerateRequest:
             kw["video_data"] = None if x is None else decode_MediaInput(x)
         elif key == "audio_data":
             kw["audio_data"] = None if x is None else decode_MediaInput(x)
+        elif key == "extra_key":
+            kw["extra_key"] = None if x is None else decode_StringOrList(x)
     return GenerateRequest(**kw)
 
 
@@ -1145,6 +1148,8 @@ def encode_GenerateRequest(v: GenerateRequest) -> Dict[str, Any]:
         d["video_data"] = encode_MediaInput(v.video_data)
     if v.audio_data is not None:
         d["audio_data"] = encode_MediaInput(v.audio_data)
+    if v.extra_key is not None:
+        d["extra_key"] = encode_StringOrList(v.extra_key)
     return d

@@ -374,6 +374,11 @@ pub struct GenerateRequest {
     pub video_data: ::core::option::Option<MediaInput>,
     #[prost(message, optional, tag = "22")]
     pub audio_data: ::core::option::Option<MediaInput>,
+    /// Prefix-cache namespace: requests share cached prefixes only under the same
+    /// key. One key for every batch item, or one per item; an empty key means
+    /// none.
+    #[prost(message, optional, tag = "23")]
+    pub extra_key: ::core::option::Option<StringOrList>,
 }
